subject: Risk & Compliance
title: ESG Reporting and Greenwashing
description: One-minute skill: ESG Reporting and Greenwashing.

hook.text: A company claims to be carbon neutral. An investigation reveals it bought cheap offsets that planted no trees.

buildup.text: ESG reporting measures environmental, social, and governance performance. Investors use it to evaluate sustainability.

discovery.text: The EU's Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive requires 50,000 companies to disclose detailed ESG data.

twist.text: Greenwashing — misleading sustainability claims — is now prosecuted. DWS paid $25M for overstating ESG credentials.

climax.text: ESG reporting is moving from voluntary to mandatory. Companies that greenwash face fines and reputational destruction.

punchline.text: Carbon neutral on paper. No trees planted. That's greenwashing.

quiz.question: What is greenwashing?
options: Making misleading claims about environmental sustainability
Washing buildings with green cleaning products
